_schema_note: Each entry: pattern is a Python regex run against (title + body). reply is markdown commented on the issue. close: true marks the issue closed. label: optional GitHub label to apply. First match wins (top-to-bottom). Edit + commit to refine.

patterns.name: no-lockfile
patterns.label: user-error/lockfile
patterns.reply:
Hi — looks like you don't have a `cygnus.lock` yet. **Run `cygnus lock` from your project root to generate one**, then retry `cygnus verify --from-lock`.

As of v0.1.3+, `cygnus verify --from-lock` will offer to generate the lockfile for you interactively (or pass `--auto-lock` for CI). If you're on an older CLI, update via `curl -fsSL https://install.blackswan-software.ai | sh`.

Closing — reopen if this doesn't solve it.

patterns.name: command-not-found
patterns.pattern: (?i)(command not found.*cygnus|cygnus.*command not found|cygnus: not found|cygnus: command not found)
patterns.label: user-error/install
patterns.reply:
Sounds like the CLI isn't on your `PATH`. 

Install (or reinstall) via:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://install.blackswan-software.ai | sh
```

Then confirm `~/.local/bin` is on `$PATH`:

```bash
echo $PATH | tr ':' '\n' | grep .local/bin
```

If missing, add `export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"` to your shell init (e.g. `~/.bashrc`).

Closing — reopen if you still see this after a fresh install.

patterns.name: glibc-mismatch
patterns.label: user-error/old-binary
patterns.reply:
This was a bug in v0.1.0 — the binary was built on GLIBC 2.38 and wouldn't load on Ubuntu 22.04 / Debian 12 / older. **Fixed in v0.1.1+**.

Reinstall to pick up the current build:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://install.blackswan-software.ai | sh
```

The install script defaults to `latest` which auto-tracks the newest release. Verify with `cygnus --version` afterward.

Closing — reopen if you still see GLIBC errors after upgrading.

patterns.name: library-not-registered
patterns.label: request/library
patterns.reply:
Looks like the library isn't yet in the verification registry. You can request it:

```bash
cygnus issue --library <name>
```

We auto-compile + verify popular libraries within 24 hours, longer-tail within a few days. The issue you filed acts as a request — leaving open as a tracking ticket.

If you'd like priority, the Verified tier (Verified-tier deposit) gets your request bumped.

patterns.name: 403-paid-tokens
patterns.label: user-error/tier
patterns.reply:
Verified tokens (the cryptographically-signed manifests) are paid-tier only. Free tier gets verified status + CVE info (`cygnus verify <lib>`) but not the underlying token JSON.

To enable, deposit see pricing page:

```bash
cygnus deposit <USD>
```

Docs: <https://blackswan-software.ai/pricing>

Closing — reopen if you've deposited and still hit 403.

patterns.name: stripe-not-enabled
patterns.label: infra/stripe-off
patterns.reply:
Stripe is not yet enabled on the production auth-service. Deposits return stub URLs in this mode. We'll enable in test mode after the launch arc completes (tracked in our internal SESSION.md).

Leaving open as a tracker — will close once `STRIPE_ENABLED=true` is set on M1. Free-tier verify still works.
